root.name: Retro Launcher
root.description: Play console ROMs on the backglass, picked from a menu on the playfield. Put ROMs (plain or .zip) in this app's roms/ folders: genesis, mastersystem, gamegear, nes, snes, atari2600, colecovision, gb, gbc, gba, pce, lynx. In a game, hold Start or press Home for the pause menu (save states, reset, quit).
